title: Entity growth batch 02 — Zerion Wallet
notes: Candidate-only breadth-growth record under issue #195. Canonical publication prohibited until Batch 02 review completes.

entities.summary: Self-custodial Web3 wallet ecosystem launched by Zerion in 2022 for multichain asset management and dApp access.
entities.notes: Zerion's first-party announcement launched Zerion Wallet on 2022-05-26 and described it as entirely self-custodial.

products.summary: Zerion self-custody mobile wallet for multichain Web3 asset management and dApp access on iOS and Android.
products.notes: The 2022-05-26 launch establishes the mobile wallet lineage. Zerion's later browser extension has its own 2023 release lifecycle and is intentionally not collapsed into this mobile product.

evidence.title: Announcing the Zerion Wallet
evidence.notes: First-party announcement launches Zerion Wallet on 2022-05-26 and explicitly describes it as entirely self-custodial.

evidence.title: Install Zerion
evidence.notes: Current first-party installation guide separately documents the Zerion mobile app for iOS/Android and Zerion browser extension, supporting WLR's decision to keep the mobile product boundary separate.
